The Gradle wrapper JAR is a binary file and is not included through the text-file GitHub editor. To make the wrapper launchers work, generate the wrapper with an installed Gradle distribution by running `gradle wrapper --gradle-version 8.11.1` from the project root, or copy `gradle-wrapper.jar` from a standard Android Studio-generated project. Android Studio's **Get from VCS** flow can still clone the project; if wrapper launch fails, use Android Studio's Gradle sync/import options.
